## ** 213 Items that are currently possible to greenstack**

## **13 Quest items **
> `Dogbone, Ketchup, Mustard, Strange Rock, Time Thingy, Employment Statistics, Corporate Sub, Instablab follower, Cloudsound Follower, Casual Confidante, Triumphant Treason, Claiming Cashe, Monster Rating`
## **9 Craftable Items**
> `Icing Ironbite, Saucy Logfries(Hard), Slurpin Herm, Buttered Toasted Butter, Peanut, Bucket of Slush, Bullet, FMJ Bullet, Coldseeker Bullet `
## **68 Monster Materials**
> `First item of every non boss card, not listing them all. This includes Red Frisbee, bonemeal and Minuteglass which are all quite difficult.`
## **48 Gathering Skill Resources**
> ` This includes the 4 Seaslt fish and 4 Equinox resources.`
## **7 Bars**
> `This is all bars up to Lustre. You could also get Starfire with extreme dedication.`
## **10 Trapping Critters**
> ` Shinies not included, Poison Froge might be possible`
## **6 Worship Souls**
## **11 Anvil Production Items**
## **3 Salt **
> `Red, orange and Blue salt. Requires Pet companion, Doot or omniphau stacking.`
## ** 13 Shop Exclusive Items**
> **`W2 (difficult)-`**  `Saucy Weiner, Golden Dubloon `
> **`W3 (difficult)-`**  `Sheepie Dairy, Yeti Ham. Yeti Ham is also dropped by Bop Boxes, I do not know the rates. `
> **`W4 -`**  `Cupcake, Spicy Space Ribs, Potent Strength, speed, life and exp potions  `
> **`W5 -`**  `Lemon Slice, Grilled Cheese Nomwhich, Magma Barrel `
## **5 Statues**
> `Chopping, Mining, Speed, Beholder and Feasty. Power and Health are also plausible but will take approximately 3 times longer than the other  `
## **22 Crystal Drops**
> **`W1 (These will be acquired if you farm statues) -`**  `Small Mana, Speed and Strength potions. Average Mana and Strength Potions. Nomwhich, Hotdog, Cheezy Pizza, Grass Leaf.`
> **`W2 -`**  `Kebab Sticks, Meat Pie, Average Speed Potion, Decent Life Potion, Twisty leaf`
> **`W3 -`**  `Mountain Bread, Decent Strength Potion, Average Exp Potion, Arctic leaf  `
> **`W4 -`**  `Potent Mana Potion, Galactic leaf `
> **`W5 -`**  `Quotient Exp Potion, Magma Leaf`
## **Other Notable Drops**
> **`Should only be done if you have no other option, or are a completionist.`**
> **Small Life Potion**
> `This will be greenstacked if you farm quest items. It is also needed in crafting Saucy Logfries, but will require quite a bit of additional farm time.`
> **Average life Potion**
> `Only drops from Gigafrogs. It can be greenstacked, but is slow.`
> **Bottled Town Teleport, Tool Upgrade Stone I, Mystery Upgrade Stone I, Weapon Upgrade Stone I, Armor Upgrade Stone I and Mystery Stone II**
> `These are technically achievable. The time required though is extremely high, dedicated DK Bean farmers will eventually get these.`

**TIPS**
<:block:1110959753800196247> Do not forget to take the quest for Monster Ratings when farming Casual Confidante, Triumphant Treason and Claiming Cashe! This will net you ~⅓ of the greenstack.
<:block:1110959753800196247> Red Frisbee Should be sampled on Vman during a void run! This  nets the highest possible sample.

<:block:1110959753800196247>Best way to farm bonemeal is on an SB. A lucky trigger of a plunderous mob easily gets you days worth of progress. Do it at the beginning of your weekly reset and hope for giants as well!

<:block:1110959753800196247>  Bars, Souls and Anvil Production Items can all be done at the same time on a Siege Breaker.
<:block:1110959753800196247> When crafting Coldseeker Bullets, its a good idea to do some on each character to boost their Smithing Levels.
